name: Cooked: Fitness Super App
subtitle: Workouts, food and sleep
promo: Train, eat and recover in one app. Follow a program, log every set, track food and macros, and see your progress add up.
description:
Cooked puts your training, food and recovery in one place, so you stop juggling five apps.

TRAIN
- Follow a ready-made program like Push Pull Legs, 5x5 Strength or Upper / Lower, or build your own
- Log every set and rep as you lift, with rest timers and your last numbers right there
- An exercise library with clear form cues for every move
- Interval timers, yoga, mobility and breathing sessions

EAT
- Count calories and macros, or follow a diet plan
- Save meals you eat often and add them again in one tap
- Plan the week ahead with meal prep and a grocery list
- Track water and intermittent fasts

MOVE AND RECOVER
- Track runs, walks and hikes with GPS
- Steps from Apple Health
- Sleep tracking, sleep sounds and a recovery check before you train

STAY ON TRACK
- Weigh-ins, records and progress over time
- Train with friends and share progress if you choose
- Connect with a personal trainer who uses Cooked PT, and share only what you allow

Add only the tools you want: medicine and period trackers, gyms near you, travel mode and more live in Apps, so your home screen stays simple.

Cooked+ adds the extra features and is part of Arise All Access, a monthly subscription you can buy in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews each month unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Cooked is not a medical device and doesn't give medical advice. Talk to a doctor before starting a new exercise or eating plan.

reviewNotes: Sign in with the account above (tap Sign in, then use the username and password). It's a sample account with Arise All Access switched on, so every paid feature can be seen, and it already has a few weeks of workouts, food and weigh-ins. Apple Health, location (runs and nearby gyms), camera (form check, scanning machines) and notifications are asked for only when a feature that needs them is opened. To test buying, Arise All Access is the in-app subscription on the plan screen.
